title: Staying in a talk past three rounds is a 5-year item
summary: CDC says that by about age 5 most children keep a conversation going through more than three rounds.
body: The communication milestones for 5 years include keeping a conversation going with more than three back-and-forth exchanges. The stress is on not stopping after a single reply. Clear pronunciation is a different line on the same page. CDC's most is the three-quarters mark described on its key-points page, and a missed line is not a diagnosis. Only this US age page uses the 'more than three' count.

sources.title: Learn the Signs. Act Early. milestone page
